hook: This $399 smart ring packs a screen and a joystick, but does it actually work?

sections.voiceover: This $399 smart ring packs a screen and a joystick, but does it actually work?
sections.visual_cue: Close-up shot of the Aina smart ring on a finger showing the screen and joystick.
sections.sfx_cue: Soft mechanical click of a joystick.
b_roll: Macro product shot of Aina smart ring

sections.voiceover: On November 5, 2026, the startup Aina released this titanium wearable. Aina built a colorful OLED display, joystick, microphone, and speaker into titanium. How long does Aina's ring power an OLED display, joystick, microphone, and speaker?
sections.visual_cue: Split screen showing the titanium ring casing and a person interacting with the OLED display.

sections.voiceover: But the catch is that Aina's ring lasts just 18 hours on a single charge.
sections.visual_cue: Battery icon draining on a minimalist background.

sections.voiceover: Aina raised 5.5 million USD in funding to develop this hardware.
sections.visual_cue: Graphic showing the funding amount rising on a chart next to the ring.

sections.voiceover: The Aina ring arrives with a premium $399 price tag.
sections.visual_cue: Wide shot of the Aina smart ring in its packaging.
